leadText:
----
 
 
monpoké Short Animation (Japanese: モンポケショートアニメ monpoké Short Anime) is a series of animated shorts for the official Pokémon baby brand, monpoké. It was announced on December 18, 2024, and consists of 10 episodes, each approximately five minutes long.

Like the previous Fun Times on monpoké Island puppet show video series, the shorts feature along with , , , and on monpoké Island. Episodes are being released every Wednesday on the Japanese Pokémon Kids TV YouTube channel, with the first two episodes having been released on February 19, 2025.
